schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families to help meet agricultural input and domestic needs.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Rs. 6,000 per year per eligible farmer family, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer.
schemes.eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land recorded in their names, subject to the scheme's exclusion criteria. State and Union Territory governments identify eligible beneficiaries.
schemes.documents_required: Official guidelines refer to farmer and family details, land records, Aadhaar or permitted identification details, and bank account number with IFSC. Confirm the current document requirements with the official portal.
schemes.application_process: Use the official PM-KISAN portal for New Farmer Registration and beneficiary status. eKYC is mandatory for registered beneficiaries. Final eligibility and verification are handled under the official scheme process.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against specified crop losses caused by notified natural risks and other covered events.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Maximum farmer premium rates are 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial and horticultural crops, subject to scheme rules.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including eligible tenant farmers and sharecroppers, subject to insurable interest and applicable state requirements.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar details, bank account details, land records or permitted tenancy documents, crop details and other documents required under the applicable state notification.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Crop Insurance Portal, an authorised bank, Common Service Centre or other notified channel within the applicable season deadline.

schemes.scheme_name: Soil Health and Fertility Scheme (Soil Health Card)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme that provides soil test reports and recommendations to help farmers understand soil nutrient status and improve soil health.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides soil health information and recommendations on nutrients and fertiliser use. It is not a direct cash assistance scheme.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers across India, subject to state implementation and availability of soil testing services.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer details, land details and location information as required by the implementing agriculture officer.
schemes.application_process: Contact the local agriculture department or Block Agriculture Officer for soil sample collection and testing.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A scheme promoting organic farming through cluster-based adoption, organic certification, training and market linkages.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides support for organic farming inputs, training, certification and marketing through approved implementation plans and applicable guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and institutions adopting organic farming, subject to scheme conditions and approved implementation plans.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity and landholding details, bank account information and enrolment or cluster-related documents as required by the implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Contact the implementing agriculture department or Regional Council for cluster enrolment and application details.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A voluntary contributory pension scheme providing old-age social security to eligible small and marginal farmers.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Eligible subscribers receive a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after attaining 60 years of age, subject to scheme conditions. Farmer contributions are matched by the Central Government.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers generally aged 18 to 40 years with cultivable landholding up to two hectares, subject to prescribed exclusion criteria.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar number, bank account details and landholding information.
schemes.application_process: Eligible farmers can enrol through a Common Service Centre or the official Maandhan portal. Monthly contributions depend on the farmer's age at enrolment.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: An umbrella Centrally Sponsored Scheme promoting sustainable agriculture and the development of agriculture and allied sectors. It gives State Governments flexibility to plan projects according to local agricultural priorities.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports state-approved agricultural development projects and interventions. Benefits depend on the approved state action plan and the relevant scheme component. It is not a uniform direct cash payment to every farmer.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and agricultural stakeholders may benefit through approved state-level projects and interventions. Specific eligibility depends on the component and project.
schemes.documents_required: Documents depend on the specific component or state-approved project. Farmers should confirm requirements with the implementing agriculture department.
schemes.application_process: PM-RKVY is implemented through State Governments. Farmers should contact their District or Block Agriculture Office to check which approved components and activities are available locally.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A scheme promoting efficient water use in agriculture through micro-irrigation systems such as drip and sprinkler irrigation. It is implemented as a component of PM-RKVY.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Financial assistance of 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installation of eligible micro-irrigation systems, subject to scheme guidelines. Assistance is available up to five hectares per beneficiary. State governments may provide additional assistance.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers installing eligible drip or sprinkler irrigation systems, subject to state implementation rules, approved components and land-related conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity details, land records, bank account details, irrigation system and field details, and other documents required by the State Agriculture or Horticulture Department.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District or Block Agriculture or Horticulture Office in Tamil Nadu to check current application availability, approved equipment and subsidy procedures before installation.

schemes.scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme supporting the holistic development of horticulture, including fruits, vegetables, flowers, spices, plantation crops, mushrooms, medicinal plants and related activities.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides component-specific financial and technical assistance for horticulture development, planting material, protected cultivation, infrastructure, training and other approved activities. Assistance rates and cost norms vary by component and applicable guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, producer groups and other eligible beneficiaries undertaking approved horticulture activities, subject to the relevant component guidelines and state action plan.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer or applicant identity, land ownership or lease details where applicable, bank account information, project proposal and other documents specified by the State Horticulture Department.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Tamil Nadu State Horticulture Department or District Horticulture Office to check approved activities, current subsidy availability and application procedures.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme promoting access to modern agricultural machinery and equipment, particularly for small and marginal farmers. It also supports Custom Hiring Centres and farm machinery banks.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides financial assistance for eligible agricultural machinery and equipment. Assistance rates depend on the machine, beneficiary category and current guidelines. Support is also available for eligible Custom Hiring Centre projects.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers and approved groups or institutions applying for agricultural machinery or machinery-related infrastructure, subject to state targets and scheme guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar or other accepted identity details, bank account information, landholding details where applicable, machinery information and other documents requested by the state implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Check the official Agriculture Mechanization DBT portal for application availability and state-specific instructions. Tamil Nadu farmers should also confirm current targets and procedures with the District Agriculture Engineering Department.

schemes.scheme_name: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A mission to increase the production and productivity of rice, wheat, pulses, nutri-cereals and other notified crops through improved agricultural practices, demonstrations, quality seeds and crop management interventions. It was previously known as the National Food Security Mission (NFSM).
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides support through crop demonstrations, certified seed distribution, crop production and protection technologies, integrated nutrient and pest management, and farmer training. Specific assistance depends on the crop, component and state implementation plan.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating crops covered by the mission in areas selected under the state implementation plan, subject to applicable component conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity details, land and crop information, bank account details where financial assistance is applicable, and other documents specified by the implementing department.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District or Block Agriculture Office to check crop coverage, demonstrations, seed distribution, training programmes and current assistance available in the area.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Mission promoting natural farming practices, on-farm natural inputs, improved soil health and sustainable agriculture.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: An output-based incentive of Rs. 4,000 per acre per year for two years, up to one acre per farmer, is provided for eligible natural farming practices, subject to mission conditions and implementation.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, including eligible tenant farmers and sharecroppers, as well as farmer groups and organisations participating through approved natural farming clusters.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land or cultivation details, bank account information and cluster enrolment details as required by the implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District or Block Agriculture Office or the designated natural farming cluster coordinator to check enrolment and current implementation in the area.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme promoting bamboo cultivation on non-forest land, quality planting material, processing, value addition, market infrastructure and bamboo-based enterprises.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides project-based assistance for eligible bamboo nurseries, plantations, processing units and market infrastructure. Private-sector assistance is generally credit-linked and back-ended, with rates depending on the activity and applicable guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers, entrepreneurs, FPOs, cooperatives, SHGs and other approved organisations undertaking bamboo-related activities in implementing states.
schemes.documents_required: Applicant identity, land or project details, bank account information, project proposal and other documents required by the State Bamboo Mission.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Tamil Nadu State Bamboo Mission or designated State Nodal Department to check approved activities, project eligibility and current application procedures.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Central Sector financing facility supporting investment in post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides 3% annual interest subvention on eligible loans up to Rs. 2 crore and credit guarantee support subject to scheme and lending institution conditions.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers, FPOs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies, agri-entrepreneurs, cooperatives, startups and other approved entities undertaking eligible infrastructure projects.
schemes.documents_required: Applicant or organisation registration details, project report, land or asset documents where applicable, financial statements, bank details and documents required by the lending institution.
schemes.application_process: Submit an eligible project proposal through the official Agriculture Infrastructure Fund portal and approach a participating lending institution for loan appraisal and approval.

schemes.scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme for Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Central Sector Scheme promoting farmer collectivisation into Farmer Producer Organisations to improve access to inputs, credit, technology, markets and business opportunities.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Eligible FPOs can receive management cost support up to Rs. 18 lakh over three years, matching equity grant support up to Rs. 15 lakh per FPO and credit guarantee support for eligible project loans up to Rs. 2 crore, subject to scheme conditions.
schemes.eligibility: Farmer groups and eligible farmer collectives formed or supported through designated Implementing Agencies and Cluster-Based Business Organisations under the scheme.
schemes.documents_required: FPO registration certificate, member and shareholder details, board information, bank account details, business plan and documents required by the Implementing Agency.
schemes.application_process: Farmers interested in forming or joining an FPO should contact the District Agriculture Office or a designated Implementing Agency or Cluster-Based Business Organisation.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Mission for 2025-26 to 2030-31 to increase domestic pulses production, improve seed availability, expand cultivation and strengthen post-harvest infrastructure, with focus on Tur, Urad and Masoor.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Includes improved and climate-resilient seeds, free seed kits through approved state plans, support for demonstrations and procurement of Tur, Urad and Masoor from registered farmers under applicable Price Support Scheme norms. Eligible pulse processing units may receive 33% of project cost or up to Rs. 25 lakh, whichever is lower.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating targeted pulses in selected areas and participating through approved state implementation plans. Processing infrastructure assistance is subject to separate project eligibility conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land and crop details, bank account information and registration with the designated procurement agency where procurement benefits are sought. Processing projects require separate project documents.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District or Block Agriculture Office for seed distribution, demonstrations and local implementation. Farmers seeking procurement support should register through NAFED or NCCF as applicable.

schemes.scheme_name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oilseeds (NMEO-OS)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A mission running from 2024-25 to 2030-31 to increase domestic oilseed production and reduce dependence on imported edible oils. It focuses on major oilseeds, improved seed systems, clusters and value-chain development.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports improved seed availability, seed production and storage infrastructure, demonstrations, cluster-based interventions and eligible oilseed processing infrastructure. Specific farmer assistance depends on approved activities and state implementation guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified oilseed crops in participating areas and other eligible stakeholders such as FPOs, cooperatives and value-chain partners under approved interventions.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land or cultivation details, bank account information and crop details. Additional documents may be required for seed, infrastructure or group-based assistance.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District Agriculture Office or Block Agriculture Officer to check the oilseed crops, clusters and interventions approved in the district.

schemes.scheme_name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme promoting oil palm cultivation, productivity improvement, planting material, maintenance, intercropping, irrigation and processing infrastructure. Tamil Nadu is among the participating states.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides activity-based assistance for planting material, plantation maintenance, intercropping, drip irrigation, farm machinery and other approved interventions. A price assurance mechanism through Viability Gap Payment is also included, subject to scheme conditions.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and other approved stakeholders undertaking oil palm cultivation or related activities in notified and suitable areas under the state implementation plan.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land records or cultivation details, bank account information and documents required by the State Agriculture or Horticulture Department.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District Agriculture or Horticulture Office to check land suitability, approved planting areas, current assistance and enrolment procedures.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme implemented under PM-Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana that promotes sustainable agriculture through location-specific Integrated Farming System models in rainfed areas.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports approved integrated farming activities combining crops with suitable allied activities such as horticulture, livestock, fisheries, agroforestry and apiculture. Assistance depends on the approved state action plan and applicable component guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in identified rainfed areas participating in approved Integrated Farming System interventions under the state implementation plan.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land and location details, bank account information and any activity-specific documents required by the implementing department.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Block or District Agriculture Office to check whether RAD activities are being implemented in the area and which interventions are open for enrolment.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme encouraging tree plantation on agricultural land alongside crops to improve farm resilience and provide additional income opportunities. Tamil Nadu was included among the implementing states in the government scheme information.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides activity-based assistance through state implementation for eligible nursery development, boundary plantations and block plantations of approved tree species. Current rates and activities must be confirmed with the state department.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers and other approved participants undertaking agroforestry activities under the state-approved plan.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land records or cultivation details, bank account information and plantation or project details as required by the implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Contact the District Agriculture or Forest Department office to confirm current implementation, eligible tree species, plantation conditions and application procedures.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, in coordination with NITI Aayog and participating departments
schemes.description: A six-year programme beginning in 2025-26 to improve agricultural productivity in 100 selected districts through convergence of existing Central and State schemes. Its objectives include crop diversification, sustainable farming, post-harvest storage, irrigation and improved access to credit.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: This is a district-level convergence programme, not a uniform direct cash subsidy for every farmer. Benefits depend on the interventions included in the selected district's approved action plan and the eligibility rules of the participating schemes.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and agricultural stakeholders in the 100 selected districts may benefit from approved district interventions. District coverage and activity-specific eligibility must be checked before advising a farmer.
schemes.documents_required: Documents depend on the specific intervention or converged scheme. These may include farmer identity, land or cultivation details, bank account information and project-specific documents.
schemes.application_process: Check the official PMDDKY district dashboard and contact the District Agriculture Office to identify approved local interventions and their application channels.

schemes.scheme_name: National Bee Keeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
schemes.department: National Bee Board, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A government mission supporting scientific beekeeping, honey production, quality improvement, processing, storage, marketing and development of the beekeeping sector.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides project-based support for eligible beekeeping activities, equipment, infrastructure, training and value-chain development through approved implementing agencies. Assistance depends on the applicable component and guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible beekeepers, farmers, beekeeping groups, FPOs, cooperatives, entrepreneurs and institutions undertaking approved activities.
schemes.documents_required: Applicant identity, bank details, project proposal and activity-specific documents required by the implementing agency.
schemes.application_process: Contact the National Bee Board or the Tamil Nadu Agriculture or Horticulture Department to check current project opportunities and application procedures.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme intended to improve remunerative returns to farmers through price support and market intervention mechanisms for notified agricultural commodities.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Depending on the applicable component and government notification, support may include procurement of notified pulses, oilseeds and copra at Minimum Support Price, price deficiency payment or market intervention. Commodity, state, quantity and procurement-period conditions apply.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified commodities in participating states and registered under the applicable procurement or intervention arrangements.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land or cultivation records, crop details, bank account information and registration documents required by the state procurement agency.
schemes.application_process: Check current commodity notifications and registration arrangements with the Tamil Nadu Agriculture Department, designated procurement agency or notified procurement centre.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A scheme providing interest support on eligible short-term agricultural loans through the Kisan Credit Card lending system.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Provides interest subvention on eligible short-term agricultural credit. The effective interest rate and prompt repayment incentive depend on the applicable annual government notification and lending conditions.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers and other notified agricultural borrowers obtaining qualifying short-term loans through participating lending institutions under the Kisan Credit Card framework.
schemes.documents_required: Kisan Credit Card or loan application details, identity proof, land or cultivation details, bank account information and documents required by the lending institution.
schemes.application_process: Approach a participating bank, cooperative bank or other eligible lending institution to apply for or use a Kisan Credit Card and confirm current interest benefits.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A Central Sector Scheme supporting the provision of drones to selected women Self Help Groups for agricultural rental services, including spraying and other approved farm operations.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Eligible women SHGs can receive central financial assistance covering 80% of the drone package cost, subject to a maximum of Rs. 8 lakh, with the balance arranged through approved financing and convergence provisions.
schemes.eligibility: Selected women Self Help Groups identified through the scheme's implementation and livelihood support framework. It is not a general direct drone subsidy for every individual farmer.
schemes.documents_required: SHG registration and membership details, bank account information, selection and training records, and other documents required by the implementing agency.
schemes.application_process: Interested women SHGs should contact the District Rural Development Agency, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission or designated implementing authority to check selection and implementation.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A government initiative to develop digital public infrastructure for agriculture, including AgriStack, farmer and crop registries, and digital services supporting agricultural planning and delivery.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports digital agricultural infrastructure, data systems and technology-enabled services. It is not a universal direct cash subsidy for individual farmers.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and agricultural stakeholders who use or participate in digital agricultural services and registries implemented by the Central and State Governments.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, land and cultivation information, mobile number and other details required for farmer registry or relevant digital services.
schemes.application_process: Use the official state farmer registry or designated agriculture registration service and contact the local Agriculture Department for assistance with registration and corrections.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme supporting agricultural extension services, farmer training, technology transfer, demonstrations and stronger connections between agricultural research institutions and farmers. ATMA is an important extension mechanism under this framework.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports approved training programmes, demonstrations, exposure visits and agricultural extension activities. Assistance is generally delivered through approved programmes rather than as a universal cash payment.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, farmer groups and other eligible participants selected for extension, training and demonstration activities under approved state and district plans.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer identity, location and contact details, and any registration or participation documents requested by the extension centre.
schemes.application_process: Contact the nearest Agricultural Technology Management Agency, Agricultural Extension Centre, Block Agriculture Office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra for available training and demonstration programmes.

schemes.scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Seed and Planting Material (SMSP)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A programme supporting the production, multiplication, quality control, certification and availability of quality seeds and planting material for agricultural crops.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports approved seed production, seed processing, quality testing, seed distribution and related infrastructure. Farmer-level assistance and seed distribution depend on the crop, state plan and current implementation.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers, seed producers, seed organisations and other approved participants involved in seed production, multiplication or distribution.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer or producer identity, land and crop details, bank account information and registration or certification documents where applicable.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Tamil Nadu Agricultural Department, TANSEDA, State Seed Farms or local Agricultural Extension Centre to check available seed distribution and production programmes.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.description: A scheme supporting agricultural marketing infrastructure, market information, grading, standardisation, market linkages and improvements in agricultural marketing systems.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Supports eligible agricultural marketing infrastructure and market development projects through applicable components and guidelines. Assistance varies by project type, applicant category and location.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers' organisations, cooperatives, FPOs, private entities, state agencies and other approved organisations undertaking agricultural marketing projects.
schemes.documents_required: Applicant registration, project report, land or infrastructure documents, financial details, bank information and other documents required by the relevant implementing agency.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Tamil Nadu Agricultural Marketing and Agri Business Department or the relevant scheme implementing agency to check current project components and application procedures.

schemes.scheme_name: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme (KAVIADP)
schemes.department: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.description: A Tamil Nadu State Government programme intended to develop selected village panchayats through integrated agricultural interventions, including bringing fallow lands into cultivation and improving agricultural infrastructure and services.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Activities may include fallow land development, quality input distribution, crop demonstrations and other approved agricultural interventions. Benefits depend on the selected village, component and annual government orders.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in selected village panchayats and eligible participants under the approved programme components. Availability is not necessarily uniform across all villages.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar, land records such as Patta, Chitta or Adangal, bank details and any component-specific documents required by the local Agriculture Department.
schemes.application_process: Check whether the farmer's village is included in the current implementation list and contact the Block Agriculture Office or Village Agriculture Officer for available components and enrolment.

schemes.scheme_name: Chief Minister's Mannuyir Kaathu Mannuyir Kaappom Scheme (CM-MKMKS)
schemes.department: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.description: A Tamil Nadu State Government programme promoting soil health, sustainable farming and environmentally responsible agricultural practices through multiple approved components.
schemes.benefits_or_subsidy: Components include green manure seed distribution, soil health activities, integrated farming and other approved interventions. The assistance and subsidy for each component must be checked against the current government order and district implementation.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers in Tamil Nadu, subject to the specific component, land or cultivation conditions and current implementation instructions.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar, land records such as Patta and Adangal, bank account details and other documents required for the selected component.
schemes.application_process: Contact the Village Agriculture Officer or Block Agriculture Office and check the current component-wise availability through the Tamil Nadu Agrisnet scheme portal.
